pages.text: A $(item)Survey Satellite$() sits in the Interstellar Scoop as a catalyst - the Scoop works only high up or in space, which is where a satellite flies - and photographs the ground: a $(item)Satellite Image Plate$(). From 700 km, a 1.1 m mirror sees 40 cm.

The Deep Drilling Rig, drilling to the base of a plate, brings up a $(item)Lithospheric Plate Fragment$(). The Tectonic Press squeezes an exoplanet's core with our own to a core's pressure: a $(item)Planetary Core Sample$() - every rocky planet sinks its iron to the middle, at about 3GM²/(8πR⁴).
